_note: How an answer in Slovene is compared with the accepted ones (data/Grading.kt, Spelling). Each rule is [a regular expression, its replacement], applied in order to the lowercased answer without punctuation. same: spellings that are the same answer (correct). fold: letters a keyboard may lack; an answer that differs only in them is almost right, with fold_hint. loose: after fold; an answer that differs only there is almost right, with loose_hint. Hints: diacritics, accent, umlaut, apostrophe, none.
